projectName.description: Null when the project no longer belongs to the invited workspace.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up
Readiness: the database is reachable
Whether initial setup (creating the first administrator) is complete

post.summary: Create the first system administrator and close setup
post.description: Requires the deployment-supplied bootstrap secret. Creates the administrator, its personal workspace, and the record that closes bootstrap, in one transaction. Exactly one attempt can ever succeed.

403.description: No setup secret is configured on this installation

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Accepts any non-empty email string and password by shape, and checks them against what is stored; wrong, unknown, or malformed credentials all answer the same 401. On success, sets the session cookie.

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

400.description: The request body is not JSON

401.description: Wrong, unknown, or malformed email or password

get.summary: The account behind the browser's session cookie
The installation's SMTP settings, without the password
get.description: System administrators only. Every field is null while SMTP has not been configured; hasPassword says whether a secret is stored without ever returning it.

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

put.description: System administrators only. Replaces the whole configuration, password included: the stored password is never returned, so an update supplies it again, and it is stored encrypted at rest (ADR-0004). An explicit null means no username or no password. Security 'none' refuses credentials, and a password requires the deployment's encryption key.

200.description: The saved settings, without the password

400.description: The settings are invalid, or security 'none' carries credentials

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

409.description: No encryption key is configured for a password

post.summary: Send a test email to the administrator's own address
post.description: System administrators only, after SMTP is configured. The email carries a single-use token; redeeming it verifies the administrator's address. A delivery failure is a Problem whose code names the reason (smtp_unreachable, smtp_auth_failed, smtp_tls_failed, smtp_send_failed); a stored password the key cannot read is 409 smtp_password_unreadable.

200.description: The test email was sent to the administrator's own address

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

409.description: SMTP is not configured, or its stored password cannot be read with the configured key

502.description: The SMTP server refused the message; the code says why

post.summary: Redeem the verification token from the test email
post.description: For the signed-in account the token was issued to. The token is single-use and short-lived, and only this POST consumes it; opening the link in the email changes nothing.

200.description: The account, with its email verified

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, already used, or issued to another account

post.summary: Send an installation invitation
post.description: System administrators only, after SMTP is configured. Emails the invited address a single-use registration link, valid for seven days. Following the link (GET) changes nothing; the recipient registers with a POST. One pending invitation per email; re-inviting supersedes an expired, delivery-failed, or long-undelivered one in place. An invitation whose delivery is unknown may still redeem — holding the token proves the email arrived — and only a recorded failure never redeems. Answers 400 validation_failed; 401 not_signed_in; 403 not_admin; 409 account_exists, invitation_pending, smtp_unconfigured, or smtp_password_unreadable; and 502 smtp_unreachable, smtp_auth_failed, smtp_tls_failed, or smtp_send_failed.

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

409.description: The email has an account or a pending invitation, or SMTP is not configured or its stored password is unreadable

502.description: The SMTP server refused the message; the code says why

get.summary: List installation invitations
get.description: System administrators only. Every installation invitation, newest first, with recipient, inviter, target, offered grants, lifecycle timestamps, and email delivery as a separate fact. A pending invitation whose seven days have passed is reported and stored as expired. The token never appears.

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

post.summary: Resend an installation invitation
post.description: System administrators only. Rotates the link: a still-live pending invitation becomes revoked at replacement time, one past its deadline becomes expired at the deadline it passed, and a new pending invitation with a fresh seven-day deadline keeps the history. The previous link stops working. A delivery failure is recorded on the new invitation and answered as a delivery Problem; the invitation's lifecycle stays pending. Answers 409 invitation_not_pending when the invitation is accepted, declined, or revoked; invitation_pending when a concurrent invitation already owns the address; smtp_unconfigured when SMTP is missing; and smtp_password_unreadable when the stored password cannot be read. Answers 502 smtp_unreachable, smtp_auth_failed, smtp_tls_failed, or smtp_send_failed when the relay refuses the message.

200.description: The new pending invitation, with its delivery recorded

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

404.description: No invitation with this id

409.description: The invitation is accepted, declined, or revoked; the recipient already has an account; another invitation for this address is already pending; or SMTP is not configured or its stored password is unreadable

502.description: The SMTP server refused the message; the code says why

post.summary: Revoke an installation invitation
post.description: System administrators only. Only a pending, unexpired invitation is revoked; the link stops working and the row keeps its history and revocation timestamp.

403.description: Signed in, but not a system administrator

404.description: No invitation with this id

409.description: The invitation is no longer pending and unexpired

post.summary: Decline an installation invitation
post.description: The recipient declines from the emailed link. Holding the token is the capability; only a pending, unexpired invitation without failed delivery changes, and its link then stops working.

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used

post.summary: Register through an installation invitation
post.description: Redeems the token from the invitation email with the password the recipient chose, and creates the account bound to the invited email, its personal workspace, and the verified-email mark, in one transaction. Single-use: only this POST consumes the token; the link's GET changes nothing.

200.description: The account, with its email verified

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used

403.description: The inviter is no longer a system administrator

409.description: The invited email already has an account

get.summary: The workspaces the signed-in account can access
get.description: The caller's personal workspace plus every shared workspace they belong to, with whether they own each one. Another person's workspace never appears here, not even for a system administrator.

post.summary: Create a shared workspace
post.description: Creates a shared workspace and makes the signed-in human its first owner in one transaction.

201.description: The shared workspace, owned by the creator

get.summary: One workspace the signed-in account can access
get.description: The caller's personal workspace or a shared workspace they belong to. A workspace outside the caller's access answers exactly like a missing one.

404.description: No workspace with this id is accessible to the caller

get.summary: The members of a shared workspace
get.description: Owners only: the directory used to appoint another owner or remove a member. Ordinary members do not receive everyone else's address.

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace

404.description: No accessible shared workspace

post.summary: Invite an email into a shared workspace
post.description: Owners only, and the inviter's email must be verified. A single-use link valid for seven days goes to the invited address, offering workspace membership and any selected project grants. Every offered project must currently belong to the workspace. An existing account accepts it after signing in; a new address registers through it. Following the link (GET) changes nothing.

403.description: Not an owner, or the inviter's email is unverified

404.description: No shared workspace with this id is accessible to the caller

409.description: The invitee is already a member or already has a pending invitation, an offered project no longer belongs to the workspace, or SMTP is not configured or its stored password is unreadable

502.description: The SMTP server refused the message; the code says why

get.summary: List a shared workspace's invitations
get.description: Owners only. Every invitation for this workspace, newest first, with recipient, inviter, target, offered grants, lifecycle timestamps, and email delivery as a separate fact. A pending invitation whose seven days have passed is reported and stored as expired. The token never appears.

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace

404.description: No accessible shared workspace

post.summary: Resend a workspace invitation
post.description: Owners only, and the resending owner's email must be verified, exactly as for an initial invitation. Rotates the link: a still-live pending invitation becomes revoked at replacement time, one past its deadline becomes expired at the deadline it passed, and a new pending invitation from the current owner starts a fresh seven-day deadline. The previous link stops working. A delivery failure is recorded on the new invitation and answered as a delivery Problem; the invitation's lifecycle stays pending. Answers 409 invitation_not_pending when the invitation is accepted, declined, or revoked; invitation_scope_invalid when an offered project left the workspace; invitation_pending when a concurrent invitation already owns the address; smtp_unconfigured when SMTP is missing; and smtp_password_unreadable when the stored password cannot be read. Answers 502 smtp_unreachable, smtp_auth_failed, smtp_tls_failed, or smtp_send_failed when the relay refuses the message.

200.description: The new pending invitation, with its delivery recorded

400.description: The workspace or invitation id is invalid

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace, or the owner's email is unverified

404.description: No accessible shared workspace or invitation

409.description: The invitation is accepted, declined, or revoked; an offered project left the workspace; the recipient is already a member; another invitation is pending; or SMTP is not configured or its stored password is unreadable

502.description: The SMTP server refused the message; the code says why

post.summary: Revoke a workspace invitation
post.description: Owners only. Only a pending, unexpired invitation is revoked; the link stops working and the row keeps its history and revocation timestamp.

400.description: The workspace or invitation id is invalid

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace

404.description: No accessible shared workspace or invitation

409.description: The invitation is no longer pending and unexpired

post.summary: Decline a workspace invitation
post.description: The recipient declines from the emailed link. Holding the token is the capability; only a pending, unexpired invitation without failed delivery changes, and its link then stops working.

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used

get.summary: The workspace and address a workspace invitation link offers
get.description: A read-only preview of a single-use invitation token. It never consumes the token and changes nothing. It returns the workspace, invited address, inviter, deadline, and the actual offered grants, including every project and level. Invalid, expired, used, or failed-delivery links answer the same Problem. An offer whose project left the workspace answers 409 invitation_scope_invalid without returning project metadata.

200.description: The invitation's workspace and invited address

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used

409.description: An offered project no longer belongs to the workspace

post.summary: Accept a workspace invitation as an existing account
post.description: Redeems the emailed token for the signed-in account. The account's verified email must equal the invited address; a forwarded link cannot attach the membership to another account. Every offered project is rechecked against the workspace and the project grants are applied in the same transaction. The token is consumed only by this POST.

200.description: The workspace, now a membership of the signed-in account

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used

403.description: The signed-in account has a different or unverified email, or the inviter no longer has authority

409.description: The account is already a member of the workspace, or an offered project no longer belongs to it

post.summary: Register a new account through a workspace invitation
post.description: Redeems the token for an address with no account, creating the account, its personal workspace, the verified-email mark, the workspace membership, and the offered project grants in one transaction. Every offered project must still belong to the workspace. An existing account answers account_exists and signs in to accept instead.

200.description: The account, with its email verified and the membership created

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used

403.description: The inviter no longer has authority to invite to this workspace

409.description: The invited email already has an account, or an offered project no longer belongs to the workspace

post.summary: Appoint a member as another owner
post.description: Owners only. The target must already be a member; an existing owner is returned unchanged.

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace

404.description: No accessible shared workspace or member

patch.summary: Grant or revoke a member's Create projects capability
patch.description: Owners only. An owner can always create projects; this capability lets one member create projects without workspace-wide authority. The created project's creator receives Manage on it, and membership alone still grants no existing project's content.

200.description: The member with the effective capability

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace

404.description: No accessible shared workspace or member

409.description: Workspace owners always have Create projects

delete.summary: Remove a member from a shared workspace
delete.description: Owners only. Removing an owner is refused when it would leave the workspace with no owner. The removed human keeps their personal workspace and every other membership.

400.description: The workspace or member id is invalid

403.description: Not an owner of this workspace

404.description: No accessible shared workspace or member

409.description: Removing this owner would leave the workspace with no owner

get.summary: The projects the caller can access in a workspace
get.description: A personal workspace's owner sees its projects. A shared workspace's owner sees every project; an ordinary member sees only the projects explicitly granted to them. Membership alone never reveals a project. A workspace outside the caller's access answers exactly like a missing one.

200.description: The accessible projects in the workspace

404.description: No workspace with this id is accessible to the caller

post.summary: Create a project in a workspace
post.description: A personal workspace's owner or a shared workspace's owner can always create a project. A shared member needs the Create projects capability; the member who creates a project receives Manage on it. The project belongs to the workspace, its creator is recorded as authorship, and the creation is recorded in the project's activity.

201.description: The project, created in the workspace

403.description: The caller does not have Create projects in this workspace

404.description: No workspace with this id is accessible to the caller

get.summary: One project the caller can access
get.description: A project's own view. A project outside the caller's access answers exactly like a missing one, so ids cannot be enumerated.

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

patch.description: Manage access may rename the project. A request that does not change the name returns the project unchanged and records no event.

403.description: Read or Contribute access cannot configure the project

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

get.summary: The explicit access grants on a project
get.description: Manage only. Workspace owners have implicit Manage and are not listed; a personal project has no collaborators and answers with an empty list.

403.description: Read or Contribute access cannot manage project access

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

patch.summary: Grant or change a member's project access
patch.description: Manage only. The target must be a current member of the project's shared workspace. The level is one of Read, Contribute, or Manage; a real change records an attributed access event in the same transaction.

403.description: Read or Contribute access cannot manage project access, or the project is personal

404.description: No accessible project or workspace member

409.description: Workspace owners already have Manage access to every project

delete.description: Manage only. Revoking is idempotent: a person with no grant is already in the desired state. A real revocation records an attributed access event.

400.description: The project or member id is invalid

403.description: Read or Contribute access cannot manage project access, or the project is personal

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

409.description: Workspace owners already have Manage access to every project

get.summary: The issues in a project
get.description: Every issue in the project, oldest number first, with its author and last editor.

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

post.summary: Create an issue in a project
post.description: Contribute or Manage. The issue gets the project's next local number, starts open, and records its creator. The creation is recorded in the project's activity.

403.description: Read access cannot create an issue

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

get.summary: One issue the caller can access
get.description: The issue's title, Markdown body, status, and authorship.

404.description: No issue with this id is accessible to the caller

patch.summary: Edit, close, or reopen an issue
patch.description: Contribute or Manage. Every field is optional. A title or body change records an edit; a status change records a close or a reopen. A request that changes nothing returns the issue unchanged and records no event.

403.description: Read access cannot change the issue

404.description: No issue with this id is accessible to the caller

get.summary: The comments on an issue
get.description: The issue's comments in the order they were written, each with its author.

404.description: No issue with this id is accessible to the caller

post.summary: Comment on an issue
post.description: Contribute or Manage. A comment needs no work session (#20), only project access. It records its author and appears in the project's activity.

403.description: Read access cannot comment

404.description: No issue with this id is accessible to the caller

get.summary: A project's activity
get.description: Project creation, issue creation, edits, comments, closes, reopens, and knowledge creation and edits, in the order they happened, each with the human who caused it.

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

get.description: A title and a Markdown body per entry, with who created and last edited it. This is the basic entry from #26, not the full vault editor (#6).

post.description: Contribute or Manage. Stores the title and Markdown body as written, records the creator, and adds a creation event to the project's activity.

404.description: No project with this id is accessible to the caller

get.description: The entry's title, Markdown body, and authorship.

404.description: No knowledge entry with this id is accessible to the caller

patch.summary: Edit a basic Markdown knowledge entry
patch.description: Contribute or Manage. Every field is optional. A real change records the editor and adds an edit event; a no-op returns the entry unchanged.
